agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py's group_values(): corrected an inverted isinstance check (`if not isinstance(token, sql.Parenthesis)` -> `if isinstance(token, sql.Parenthesis)`) that determines the end boundary when grouping the VALUES keyword with its following Parenthesis into a sql.Values node. This bug caused INSERT...VALUES statements to be grouped incorrectly, breaking reindent formatting (e.g. 'insert into foo values (1, 2)' no longer produced 'insert into foo\nvalues (1, 2)'). Verified the fix manually with single-row and multi-row VALUES clauses, and confirmed unrelated formatting (e.g. SELECT) is unaffected.
